hypothesis: BYD's large current capital investments, especially flash charging infrastructure, will produce durable future monopoly-like income despite near-term disappointing performance.
interpretation: Monopoly-like income means durable excess economic returns attributable to the investment, not merely charging revenue or legal monopoly status. No consensus-expectations dataset is supplied, so disappointing performance is tested only as explicitly dated reported changes.

propositions.claim: Investment and charging-network deployment are substantial.
obligations: Separate group cash investment from charging-specific spending
Separate plans from completed stations and stations from connectors

propositions.claim: The infrastructure produces persistent customer value and improved BYD vehicle economics.
obligations: Measure accessible effective charging time, availability and cohort use
Identify incremental vehicle demand or margin against a credible counterfactual

propositions.claim: BYD captures durable above-normal returns from that value.
obligations: Observe ownership, contracts and retained cash margins
Account for competitors, customer substitution, capital cost and maintenance

propositions.claim: The investment improves shareholder value over 2027-2030.
obligations: Avoid double-counting charging benefits already in vehicle margin
Observe returns on incremental invested capital and funding needs
Separate enterprise success from the price paid for shares

paths.limitations: Shared BYD source family; missing station-day exposure and signed revenue-sharing contracts
Group aggregate; no charging segment causal attribution
Supplier announcements are not comparable independent field tests

missing_data: Operating station-days and mature cohort throughput
Net service margin retained by BYD after partners and subsidies
City/model-level untreated comparison for incremental vehicle profit
Consensus forecasts frozen before each earnings announcement

measurements.limitations: Partner agreements and capital attribution are required; this edge is a candidate inference, not an established valid mapping
